title: A1: backup.ts — GCS last-good backup + restore module with unit tests
description:
Plan: .agents/plans/2026-09-05_16-34-obsidian-down-last-good-cache.md — Workstream A, step 1 (epic tk-vau).

New module src/backup.ts (~70 lines, no new deps):
- Structural interface for the GCS File API subset (exists/getMetadata/download/save) — same fake-able shape as GcsBucketLike (src/asset/store/gcs.ts:7).
- openBackupBucket() → new Storage().bucket(BACKUP_GCS_BUCKET ?? ASSETS_GCS_BUCKET); null when neither set (dev = clean no-op).
- backupStoreFiles(dataDir, files): sha256 per file; object _backup/<file>; skip when remote metadata.sha256 matches (8.4MB catalog runs on every sync — upload only on change); else save with contentType application/json + sha256 metadata.
- restoreMissingFiles(dataDir, files): download + atomic write (tmp+rename via writeJsonAtomic pattern, src/store.ts:59) ONLY when local file is missing or 0 bytes. Never overwrites present files.
notes: src/backup.ts (91 lines, no new deps) + src/backup.test.ts: 8/8 green. Sha256-gated upload under _backup/, restore fills missing/empty only, atomic tmp+rename, null-bucket no-op. resumable:false (local bun client quirk; node + prod alpine bun fine).
acceptance_criteria: src/backup.test.ts with in-memory fake bucket (follow store/store.contract.test.ts): upload writes object with sha256 metadata; identical second run makes NO save call; changed local file triggers save; restore writes file when local missing; restore SKIPS when local file exists non-empty; all ops no-op without bucket config. bun test src/backup.test.ts green; full bun test green.
